purpose: Prioritize independently measurable AS-06 improvements following submission115506 score0.9122153056.
hypothesis: Better calibrated Jamo scoring and more diverse offline pronunciations may improve candidate selection and retrieval without online LM cost.
changed_factors: Separate original romanized and Jamo features; compare bounded single Jamo correction.
Compare first-token branching with quality-controlled diverse pronunciation generation.
Add length-normalized Jamo2-4gram retrieval as a separate channel.
Audit lookup fallback and missing-tonnage handling independently.
fixed_conditions: Read existing Group5folds; do not regenerate
Fit every learned asset within the appropriate fold
Do not build or update ZIP without explicit request
observations: Current Top-K generation branches only at first token then uses greedy continuation.
Jamo similarity influences multiple score components and final lattice refinement.
The six missing names and4348 single-pronunciation names are measured coverage facts, not measured accuracy gains.
interpretations: Score correction is the first proposed experiment due to low implementation cost and directly observed feature dependence.
Pronunciation diversity is a retrieval hypothesis, not demonstrated cause of server errors.
limitations: No hidden test rows or individual predictions available.
No new model training or performance evaluation executed.
No component gain, target score, inference latency or statistical significance claimed.
Fold0 metadata is not proof that all data lineage is leak-free.
decision: Save concrete plan; retain AS-06 as reference; execute no training/ZIP based solely on improvement-advice request.
next_actions: On an implementation request, preserve AS-06 and resolve generator/fold provenance first.
Run one changed factor at a time with fix/break, subgroup and cost reporting.
